citations: - catalog.md::chunk0, Summer Beverages 1997: The return window is mentioned in this context as "Dates: 1997-06-01 to 1997-06-30". This indicates that the summer beverage category has a promotion or event running from June 1st to June 30th, which translates into a return window of 30 days.

sql: SELECT p.CategoryID, SUM(oi.Quantity) AS total_quantity FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.ProductID = p.ProductID WHERE strft Expressions('1997-06-01', 'YYYY') <= OrderDate AND OrderDate < strf Expr sion ('1997-06-30', 'YYYY') GROUP BY p.CategoryID ORDER BY total_quantity DESC LIMIT 1;

SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.UnitPrice * oi.Quantity * (1 - oi.Discount)) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.OrderID), 2) AS AOV
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items oi ON o.OrderID = oi.OrderID
JOIN products p ON oi.ProductID = p.ProductID
JOIN Categories c ON p.CategoryID = c.CategoryID
WHERE strftime('%Y', o.OrderDate) = '1997' 
AND (c.CategoryName IN ('Beverages', 'Condiments', 'Confections', 'Dairy Products', 'Grains/Cereals', 'Meat/Poultry', 'Produce', 'Seafood'))
GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', o.OrderDate);

SELECT p.ProductName, SUM(oi.UnitPrice * oi.Quantity * (1 - COALESCE((SELECT Discount FROM order_items WHERE OrderID = oi.OrderID), 0))) AS revenue 
FROM products p
JOIN order_items oi ON p.ProductID = oi.ProductID 
GROUP BY p.ProductName 
ORDER BY SUM(oi.UnitPrice * oi.Quantity * (1 - COALESCE((SELECT Discount FROM order-order_details WHERE OrderID = oi.OrderID), 0))) DESC 
LIMIT 3;

SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.UnitPrice * oi.Quantity * (1 - COALESCE(p.Discount, 0))), 2) AS TotalRevenue FROM orders o INNER JOIN order_items oi ON o.OrderID = oi.OrderID LEFT JOIN products p ON oi.ProductID = p.ProductID LEFT JOIN Categories c ON p.CategoryID = c.CategoryID WHERE strftime('%Y-%m-01', '1997-06-01') <= OrderDate AND (strftime('%Y-%m-01', '1997-07-01') >= OrderDate OR orderdate IS NULL) AND c.CategoryName = 'Beverages' GROUP BY p.CategoryID;

SELECT c.CompanyName AS `customer`, SUM(oi.UnitPrice * oi.Quantity * (1 - IFNULL(p.UnitPrice, 0.7 * p.UnitPrice))) / NULLIF(SUM(p.UnitPrice), qty) AS margin 
FROM customers c 
JOIN orders o ON c.CustomerID = o.CustomerID 
JOIN order_items oi ON o.OrderID = oi.OrderID 
LEFT JOIN products p ON oi.ProductID = p.ProductID 
WHERE strftime('%Y', o.OrderDate) = '1997' AND qty IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY c.CompanyName 
ORDER BY margin DESC LIMIT 1;
